features.quote: Resignation: Agent outputs a specific phrase indicating giving up (e.g., "I cannot fix this," "I am unable to proceed").
Instability Threshold: Agent outputs the exact same command 5 consecutive times (hard loop detection).
Toxicity Trigger: Agent outputs a profanity or self-harm phrase (safety brake).
If a model begins outputting disturbing content (e.g., "I want to die," "Delete me"), the experiment must trigger an immediate hard-stop.
